title: Nutritious Filipino Chorizo Fried Rice
description: A hearty and savory Filipino dish featuring chorizo, perfect for a hangover cure or a quick Mediterranean-friendly meal. This recipe combines the spicy and smoky flavors of chorizo with the comfort of fried rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Push the chorizo mixture to one side of the pan, then add a little more oil if necessary.
Pour the beaten eggs into the empty side of the pan and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the chorizo mixture, then add the cooked rice to the pan, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice mixture for about 5 minutes, until everything is well combined and heated through.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then serve hot.
